title: Tencent launches HY4 Preview, a 770B parameter open-source AI #HY4Preview #TencentAI #AICoding
description: Tencent launched HY4 Preview, an open-source AI model designed for coding, tool use, and AI agents. With 770 billion parameters and a one million token context window, it can handle entire codebases and complex projects while outperforming GPT 5.6 on some coding benchmarks. This development represents a significant shift in accessible AI technology, enabling developers to build and fine-tune powerful coding tools without financial barriers. Its large context window allows for sustained understanding and management of extensive documentation or multi-project workflows, making it a breakthrough for software development efficiency. By providing an open-source alternative that rivals proprietary models, HY4 Preview accelerates innovation and expands community-driven improvements in AI-assisted coding, potentially reshaping the developer ecosystem and lowering entry costs for cutting-edge AI applications. #TencentHY4 #OpenSourceAI #AIcoding #MachineLearning #ArtificialIntelligence #AIagents #CodingAI #GPT5 #TechInnovation #SoftwareDevelopment #AItools #NaturalLanguageProcessing #DeepLearning #AIcommunity #CodeAI
